eligibility_rule: all declared sources are readable and content-identifiable
notes: Replaces hidden path and URL reads with an explicit provenance boundary.

eligibility_rule: source inventory and run identity are valid
notes: One identity is shared by directory manifest and outputs; latest is only a pointer.

eligibility_rule: scientific run has no tracked-repository side effect
notes: Separates data-dictionary generation from a scientific run and preserves the current engine.

eligibility_rule: core contract is readable and keys are valid
notes: Unreadable core inputs broken keys and corrupt run identity stop the run.

eligibility_rule: proposed semantic changes have preview and approval basis
notes: Source rows remain immutable; reviewed inference is explicit and overrideable.

eligibility_rule: each retained event and repaired value links to source-row identity
notes: Publishes event membership and repair lineage rather than opaque row loss.

eligibility_rule: identifiers and deployment intervals resolve without broken keys
notes: Nominal station physical location deployment and analysis_site remain distinct.

eligibility_rule: profile version precedence defaults and named scales resolve and persist
notes: Standard guided advanced and CLI views share this contract; public fields remain open.

eligibility_rule: deployment interval and temporal evidence support a stated effort rule
notes: Deployment intervals are conservative default; zero versus unknown is an accepted invariant.

eligibility_rule: configured operational gap and source-row membership are available
notes: Terminology is operational detection event and membership is published.

eligibility_rule: adapter maps supplied CamtrapDP package to the same resolved contract
notes: CamtrapDP compatibility is an adapter boundary not a parallel analysis.

eligibility_rule: all module prerequisites are evaluated before execution
notes: Separates integrity-stop from analytical omission.

eligibility_rule: every requested module emits one allowed status
notes: Allowed statuses are completed completed_with_warnings omitted or failed.

eligibility_rule: effort and core labelled records meet the accepted profile prerequisites
notes: Aggregator records the claim limits and delegates to module-level capabilities.

eligibility_rule: confirmed effort and labelled detections support observed richness at named resolution
notes: Observed richness is not unseen-richness estimation and remains effort/scale bounded.

eligibility_rule: shared analytical unit and effort-aware inputs support descriptive turnover
notes: Turnover is illustrative until the versioned entity crosswalk and analytical resolution are explicit.

eligibility_rule: selected species and comparable effort support within-survey rates
notes: Measure is never abundance or density.

eligibility_rule: temporal rule and minimum-cell evidence support coarse day/night
notes: Rejects precise diel inference and suppresses inadequate cells.

eligibility_rule: event rule and source membership support sensitivity comparison
notes: Sensitivity does not convert operational events into independent animals.

eligibility_rule: documented site crosswalk and design evidence pass a later eligibility gate
notes: Omitted for current Judbury fixture unless Barry approves a defensible design gate.

eligibility_rule: complete trait and covariate evidence supports requested inference
notes: No unconditional model or fabricated optional fields.

eligibility_rule: all module results have structured references and statuses
notes: Replaces monolithic publication with three linked layers without duplicating the engine.

eligibility_rule: manifest and all referenced files pass identity provenance CRS and error-state checks
notes: Independent file-plus-manifest coupling; no shared DAG cache or network dependency.

eligibility_rule: CLI and machine contract resolve one shared configuration and outputs
notes: The authoritative contract precedes any guided interface.

eligibility_rule: selected local interface controls the same engine without semantic drift
notes: Compare local approaches; do not choose GUI or deployment substrate here.

eligibility_rule: independent or synthetic case passes adapter manifest and cross-layer checks
notes: Judbury alone cannot support a general software-product claim.

eligibility_rule: explicit scientific and egress gates are approved before any downstream spike
notes: ALA/regional context and AI interpretation remain optional downstream work with no raw-data egress by default.
